title: TypeSomething typewriter
description: Inline text that types words letter by letter, holds, erases and moves to the next, with a hard-blinking underscore cursor. Can reserve the longest word's width so the line never shifts.
notes: needs JavaScript for the typing; the static HTML shows the first word in full, so nothing is hidden without it
reduced motion: the first word stays, the cursor stops blinking
name: typesomething-typewriter

props.name: words
props.description: the words typed one after another, then erased; one word types and erases itself on a loop

props.name: cursor
props.description: the glyph after the text, blinking like a terminal cursor

props.name: reserve
props.description: keep the width of the longest word, so nothing after it moves while it types

props.name: holdMs
props.description: how long a finished word stays before it's erased (ms)

props.name: gapMs
props.description: pause on an empty line before the next word (ms)

props.name: cursorClassName
props.description: classes for the cursor (e.g. a colour)
